description: Start tracking this site in another market (country, language and device). The new market copies the primary market’s tracked searches and is checked weekly (Mondays, 02:00 UTC); its checks are included in the plan and count toward keywords tracked; the primary market does not change. Nothing is bought when it is added. dry_run: true answers what would be added and when the first check runs, without adding anything. A market already tracked is refused.

dry_run.description: Answer what would be added and the first check date; add nothing.

fields.description: Top-level keys to keep, e.g. ["kpis"]: envelope keys, not metric names.

location_code.description: The country as a location code (e.g. 2840 for the United States).
